name: sftp
description: SFTP with a pinned host key: list, stat and read remote files inside SFTP_ROOT, download to an allowed local directory, upload from one (staged, no overwrite unless a node asks); agent writes opt-in, deletes node only

nodes.title: List a remote directory
nodes.description: Lists a directory on the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT (name, type, size, modified time, permission bits), sorted by name

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

include_hidden.description: Include names starting with a dot

limit.description: Most entries; `truncated` says when there were more

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Stat a remote path
nodes.description: Describes a file or directory on the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT (type, size, modified time, permission bits)

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Read a remote file
nodes.description: Reads a file on the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT as UTF-8 text or base64, up to max_bytes from offset; `truncated` says when more remains

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

encoding.description: utf8 for text (a cut may end in U+FFFD), base64 for binary

max_bytes.description: Most bytes to read (never more than SFTP_MAX_READ_BYTES)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Download a file
nodes.description: Downloads a file from the SFTP server (inside SFTP_ROOT) into a new file with a generated name in SFTP_OUTPUT_DIR; nothing local is overwritten

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

output_name.description: Start of the generated output file name (letters, digits, - and _; default: the input's name). A timestamp and random suffix are always added, so nothing is overwritten

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Upload a file
nodes.description: Uploads a local file from SFTP_INPUT_DIRS to the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT: staged under a temporary name, then renamed. Existing files are never replaced unless a workflow node passes overwrite. Agents need SFTP_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

local_path.description: Local file inside SFTP_INPUT_DIRS (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the first one)

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

overwrite.description: Replace an existing regular file (workflow nodes only; needs the server's posix-rename extension)

create_parents.description: Create missing remote directories inside SFTP_ROOT

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Make a remote directory
nodes.description: Creates a directory on the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT (with create_parents, missing parents too). Agents need SFTP_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete a remote file or empty directory
nodes.description: Deletes one file, symlink (the link itself) or empty directory on the SFTP server inside SFTP_ROOT; never recursive, never SFTP_ROOT itself (workflow nodes only)

path.description: Path on the server relative to SFTP_ROOT ("/" is SFTP_ROOT itself; .. never leaves it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
